tools.name: github_workflows
tools.description: Every GitHub Actions workflow in a repository, and whether it is active. owner and name come from the git remote.

tools.name: github_runs
tools.description: Recent workflow runs, newest first, with status and conclusion.

headSha.description: A commit. A pull request's checks are the runs for its headSha from github_pulls.

tools.name: github_run
tools.description: One workflow run with its jobs and each job's steps, to see which step failed.

tools.name: github_job_log
tools.description: The end of one job's log, with line numbers. Start with the default tail or grep for the error. truncated means earlier lines were left out; logs expire after a while, which the answer says.

tail.description: Lines from the end, after grep. Default 200, at most 2000.

grep.description: Only lines containing this, ignoring case, e.g. error.

tools.name: github_annotations
tools.description: The file, line and message GitHub flagged in one job. Faster than reading the log.

tools.name: github_artifacts
tools.description: The artifacts a workflow run left, with size and whether each has expired.

tools.name: github_pulls
tools.description: Pull requests, most recently updated first, with state, branches, review state and size.

tools.name: github_pull_files
tools.description: The files a pull request changes, with status, lines added and removed, and any old path. Name paths to get their unified diffs; a long diff comes back in parts, with a note on how to read the rest.

paths.description: Only these files, each with its patch.

offset.description: Patch line to start from, from 0. The note gives the next one.

lines.description: Patch lines to return. Default 400, at most 1000; a patch also stops at 32 KB.

tools.name: github_issues
tools.description: Issues, most recently updated first. Pull requests are left out.

tools.name: github_comments
tools.description: What people wrote under a pull request or an issue, oldest first.

number.description: A pull request or issue number.

tools.name: github_inbox
tools.description: The signed-in account's notifications: review requests, mentions and assignments, newest first.
